name: spellkave_define_resource
label: Define Resource (verb PoC)
description: PoC (#1968 FIX②): author ONE resource_definitions row (a spell-slot/HP/charge-style pool) + its resource_definition_tag satellites (#1968 verb-UX round 2) in a single call — the scaffolding step placement-tool `resources` seeds and spellkave_define_behavior's `effect.write.resource`/`cost.pool` both need to already resolve against (neither verb fabricates bounds for a pool it didn't create). Self-scaffolds the `[[bundles]]` header if `bundle` has none yet. #1968 workspace idempotency: re-authoring the SAME bundle+id REPLACES the row + EVERY tag satellite wholesale (fewer tags on a re-run means the stale ones are gone, not left behind).

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on the generated row. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle` (#1968 smart default).

id.description: Local resource stem; the full resource_definition_id is '<bundle>/<id>' (e.g. bundle='aoe_blast', id='hp' -> 'aoe_blast/hp').

display_name.description: resource_definitions.display_name. Omit to derive a title-cased `id` (#1968 smart default).

initial_value.description: resource_definitions.initial_value — the object_state seed for an un-instantiated pool. Omit to fall back to min_value at runtime (a charges/gold-shaped pool); set e.g. to max_value for an HP-shaped pool that must start full.

recovery_rule.description: resource_definitions.recovery_rule (default 'none'). Closed PoC enum over the corpus's own observed vocabulary — the field itself is open-string at the schema level (ADR-0018).

value_kind.description: resource_definitions.value_kind (default 'int' — the only value observed corpus-wide).

description.description: Sets the generated resource_definitions row's own `description` column (#1968).

tags.description: One resource_definition_tag row per tag (#1968 verb-UX round 2 — mirrors spellkave_define_entity_type/_condition/_niche's own `tags` fold instead of a separate spellkave_write_rows call).
